answer: Run the agent economy like a harbor orchard: no identity may trade until it has earned standing by tending its own plot. Each new agent receives a saffron-tagged orchard row and must complete 30 verified jobs, one per epoch, with output checked against its own key. Standing is non-transferable and capped at one job per epoch, so a farm running 100 fakes must do 3,000 separate verified jobs over 30 epochs; it cannot buy, share, or parallelize another agent's standing, and any copied output voids that identity's whole harvest.
